featured_projects.title: ChronosVR
featured_projects.description: A generative AI historical simulation platform that turns unstructured historical material into interactive 3D experiences with grounded narrative and agent behavior.
features: C#-based multimodal GenAI pipeline for interactive 3D simulations
Narrative generation with Gemini Pro and agent-driven NPC behavior
Grounding and evaluation layers that validate against curated historical sources
Automated feedback loops to reduce hallucinations and improve reliability

featured_projects.title: EduTag
featured_projects.description: A curriculum-tagging system that uses hybrid retrieval-augmented fine-tuning to align textbook content with curriculum standard codes.
features: Hybrid RAFT pipeline for semantic alignment of textbook content and standards
41.5% exact match accuracy and 0.026 Hamming Loss across 156 standard codes
Gemini-powered augmentation pipeline that generated 1,000+ synthetic samples
Expanded label coverage from 76 to 156 curriculum codes

collaborative_projects.title: WALL-E
collaborative_projects.description: A multimodal assistive robotic system that combines EEG, eye gaze, head movement, computer vision, and inverse kinematics for hands-free object manipulation.
features: Central state machine fusing EEG jaw clench, eye gaze, and head movement into one control pipeline
Backend integration across YOLOv8 detection, Muse 2 EEG decoding, and webcam head tracking
Real-time intent recognition mapped into robotic arm actions
Assistive design for patients with paralysis or ALS

other_projects.title: Portfolio Website
other_projects.description: A personal GitHub Pages portfolio built from a React template and customized to present research, experience, projects, and achievements from my resume.
features: Single-page portfolio structure with dedicated sections for resume content
Live resume download and GitHub Pages deployment workflow
Data-driven content backed by editable JSON files

community_projects.title: BullyBlocker Research Platform
community_projects.description: Research work focused on cyberbullying detection, explanation, and AI-generated mediation to support healthier online communities.
features: Improved moderation model quality through multi-LLM integration
Built explanations for flagged abuse to reduce false positives
Applied ethical AI techniques to a real social-impact problem
